{{Recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Litre|L]] (4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) [[Cookbook:Mango|mango]] nectar (strained puréed mango)
* 500 [[Cookbook:ML|ml]] (2 cups) full-fat [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yoghurt]]
* 500 ml (2 cups) chilled [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 250 ml (1 cup) [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

== Procedure ==
# Mix sugar with the mango nectar until dissolved.
# Gradually add the milk to the yoghurt.
# Mix together the mango and yoghurt mixtures.
